Grammar — Possessive Words

Complete the sentences with the correct possessive form. Number 1 is an example.

My parents sleep in this room.
It's bedroom. (example)
Jonathan lives in this house.
It's house.
Her aunt has a picture on the wall.
It's her picture.
The students have eight books.
They are the books.
Her cousins have a friendly dog.
That's her dog.
Sari has a new email address.
What's email address?
